title.narrative: IDF grant for Building capacity on Poverty M&E in the IPRCC, China

description.narrative: " Purpose: In responding to the Government's request, this IDF grant aims to (i) support and facilitate the process of building the International Poverty Reduction Center in China (IPRCC) into a center of excellence for monitoring and evaluation; (ii) help IPRCC to conduct an assessment of its institutional structure and solicit professional technical advice worldwide on the institutional structure of the IPRCC to ensure good governance, professionalism and academic standards; (iii) strengthen the research and analytical capacities on poverty analysis and M&E in the IPRCC through various means; (iv) help IPRCC establish a network of researchers and trainers on poverty analysis and M&E in China, and through the network, help build poverty analysis and M&E capacity in China's western regions. Expected Outcomes: "" In the near term, support the IPRCC to ensure the proper set up of its institutional structure which ensures its international orientation and good governance; "" In the medium term, strengthened institutional capacity in IPRCC and LGOPAD for effective knowledge sharing and mutual learning on poverty reduction; and enhanced awareness on pro-poor policy options; strengthened coherence between pro-poor policy research, design and implementation processes within China; "" Enhanced ability to conduct analytical and policy-driven research work on poverty issues, first, in collaboration with the Bank, and then independently; and develop training for Chinese as well as an international audience covering both pro-poor policies and targeted anti-poverty interventions, monitoring and evaluation. This IDF aims to support the process of building the International Poverty Reduction Center in China into a center of excellence for monitoring and evaluation; help IPRCC to establish a sound governance structure; strengthen the research and analytical capacities on poverty analysis and M & E in IPRCC; and help IPRCC to build a network of researchers and trainers for promoting South-South learning."
